title: 【青丝怨05】嫌疑人现
slug: 回溯凶案现场全警局坐等我破案
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“诶哟，你这小姑娘嘴真甜，我都五十好几了还喊我大姐呢？”大娘眼疾手快地将奶糖塞进兜里，笑得灿烂。

“那一户是王兵家……兵子是咱们厂子里头的机床维修工。他闺女儿早几个月没了，挽联打那时候起就一直贴着呢。”大娘此时的神情跟方才完全不一样，语气惋惜，

“说起来啊，兵子也是个可怜的。爹妈早些年都没了，直到二十好几有工作了才讨到媳妇儿。谁知道那妹子生孩子的时候没能下得来床，直接就去了。生下来的闺女又天生底子差，三天两头就生病。可兵子还愣是把她养活了，这一养就是养到了16岁。可也因为被她拖着，一直都没再娶一个。”

“兵子那孩子长得老实，又不爱说话，却是个热心肠的。要不是因为他家那情况，我早就给他介绍个对象了。毕竟你说哪有姑娘家乐意当后娘，还是个药罐子的后娘呢？”

“诶哟，那还真是可怜。那他闺女这么多年都过来了，怎么突然就……？”刘浩强面上扼腕叹息，心里却不停往下沉。

这个叫王兵的相关信息，已经中了孟教授侧写的一半了。

“嗐，我给你们说，你们可千万别说是我告诉的啊。”大娘鬼鬼祟祟地往左右看了看，才凑近小声道：

“那天晚上车间的机器出了问题，兵子被领导喊去修理，结果走的时候忘记关窗了。本来那孩子就生着病，这下又着凉了，等兵子回到家，就已经没气儿了！真是可惜了那么个小闺女儿，那孩子长得像她娘，漂亮得紧。特别是那头辫子，兵子爱护得很，养得跟她娘的一样滑顺。要是身体好点的话，现在都能相看婆家了。”

孟长离眸光微动，开口问道：“那他受了这么大的打击，还能坚持工作吗？工厂不得给他批假休息一段时间？”

“有的有的！给他放了很多天假呢！而且我记着他那会儿带着孩子回乡里安葬，咱们主任还亲自去了呢！”担心自己说错话惹事，大娘急忙帮领导澄清。

孟长离眉眼柔和，语气真诚地夸赞：“那你们主任还挺好的，愿意跑到乡里去悼念，毕竟王兵老家应该离城里挺远的吧？”

“可不是？兵子老家在下边的红旗大队，骑自行车都得快一个小时呢！说起来啊，这几天刚好是兵子轮休，立马就回去了，好像说前两天是他闺女的百日、恰好又是生日来着。嗐，你说这人都已经没了，哪还有必要跑那老远啊……”

涉及到自己的专业领域，大娘再一次滔滔不绝。

王建军咽了口唾沫，默默托住了自己的下巴。

红旗大队……不就是在城区下边的红旗镇上吗？

跟苏婉清娘家所在的朝阳大队就是两隔壁！

王建军看向孟长离的眼神像是在看什么怪物。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Hey, you little girl has such a sweet mouth. I'm already in my fifties and you still call me eldest sister?" The aunt quickly stuffed the toffee into her pocket and smiled brightly.

"That family belongs to Wang Bing's family... Bingzi is a machine tool repairman in our factory. His daughter died a few months ago, and she has been keeping it close to her since then." The aunt's expression at this time was completely different from before, and her tone was regretful,

"Speaking of which, Bingzi is also pitiful. His parents died a few years ago, and he didn't find a wife until he was in his twenties and had a job. Who knew that the girl couldn't get out of bed when she gave birth to the child, so she went straight away. The daughter she was born with was born with poor health, and she got sick every three days. But Bingzi still managed to raise her until she was 16 years old. But because she was dragging her down, he never married another one."

"That kid Bingzi is honest and doesn't like to talk, but he is warm-hearted. If it weren't for his family's situation, I would have introduced him to a partner long ago. After all, how can any girl be willing to be a stepmother, or a stepmother who is just a medicine pot?"

"Oh, that's really pitiful. Then his daughter has been here for so many years, why suddenly...?" Liu Haoqiang sighed sadly on his face, but his heart kept sinking.

This relevant information about Wang Bing has already covered half of Professor Meng's profile.

"Hey, I'm telling you, you must never say that I told you." The aunt looked around furtively, then leaned closer and whispered:

"There was a problem with the machine in the workshop that night. Bingzi was called by the leader to repair it, but he forgot to close the window when he left. The child was originally sick, and now he caught a cold. By the time Bingzi got home, he was already out of breath! What a pity for such a little girl. The child looks like her mother, so beautiful and tight. Especially the braid, Bingzi took good care of it and kept it as smooth as her mother's. If she were in better health, she would be able to look after her husband's family now."

Meng Changli's eyes moved slightly and he asked: "Then after suffering such a big blow, can he still keep working? The factory is not allowed to grant him leave and rest for a period of time?"

"Yes, yes! I gave him a lot of days off! And I remember that he took the child back to his hometown for burial, and our director even went there in person!" Worried that she might say something wrong and cause trouble, the aunt hurriedly helped the leader to clarify.

Meng Changli's eyebrows were soft and he praised sincerely: "Then your director is quite good. He is willing to go to the countryside to mourn. After all, Wang Bing's hometown should be quite far away from the city, right?"

"Isn't that right? Bingzi's hometown is in the Red Flag Brigade down there, and it takes almost an hour to ride a bicycle! Speaking of which, Bingzi happened to be on rotation these days, and he went back immediately. It seems that the previous two days were his daughter's 100th anniversary, and it happened to be her birthday. Well, you said that this person is already gone, so there is no need to go all the way..."

When it comes to her professional field, the aunt once again talks endlessly.

Wang Jianjun swallowed and silently held his chin.

The Red Flag Brigade...isn't it located in Hongqi Town below the city?

It's right next door to the Chaoyang Brigade where Su Wanqing's mother-in-law lives!

Wang Jianjun looked at Meng Changli as if he was looking at some monster.
